# Platform catalog

73 curated open-source components in 10 groups, installed with Helm or kustomize by `cloudseed platform install <group|item>` with values adapted to the target and distro. Versions are pinned per cloudseed release; `--version` overrides one item. Dependencies are installed first and never twice.

!!! info "Generated from the code"
    This page is generated by `scripts/gen-docs.py` from the catalog in `cloudseed/platform.py`, so it always matches the CLI you install (this build: cloudseed 0.2.0).

Legend: **core** items are installed by the group, **extra** items only by name. **FIPS**: *compatible* items install in a FIPS environment, *tls-restricted* and *crypto-restricted* items install and are flagged by `cloudseed scan fips`, items marked *no* are refused there unless `--force` ([FIPS 140 mode](../guides/security-and-fips.md)).

## Groups

| Group | What it brings | Core | Extras |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`basek8s`](#basek8s) | Cluster management: metrics, certs, Gateway API + Envoy Gateway (private LB), GitOps, observability (Prometheus, Loki), OTel, secrets | 14 | 5 |
| [`scaling`](#scaling) | Autoscaling: KEDA, VPA + Goldilocks (+ metrics-server), cluster-autoscaler / Karpenter (cloud) | 4 | 1 |
| [`data`](#data) | Data platform: MinIO, Postgres operator, Kafka, Spark, Trino, StarRocks, Polaris, Airflow, ClickHouse | 9 | 1 |
| [`ai`](#ai) | AI/ML: Ray, Kubeflow trainer/pipelines, KServe, JupyterHub, MLflow, vLLM, GPU operator, Ollama | 5 | 4 |
| [`agentic`](#agentic) | Agentic: kagent, kmcp, agentgateway, Qdrant, Langfuse, LiteLLM, Open WebUI | 4 | 3 |
| [`finops`](#finops) | FinOps: OpenCost (+ Prometheus), kube-green, Kubecost; pairs with `cs finops` for cloud bills and estimates | 1 | 2 |
| [`devsecops`](#devsecops) | DevSecOps: GitLab + runner (once GITLAB\_RUNNER\_TOKEN is set) + CI template, NeuVector, Trivy operator, ArgoCD; registries: Harbor, Artifactory, Nexus; SonarQube | 4 | 4 |
| [`security`](#security) | Security / zero trust: Istio (ambient or sidecar, strict mTLS), Falco, Kyverno policies, cert-manager + cluster CA issuer, External Secrets; extras: gateway, Kiali, Vault, Kubescape operator | 3 | 4 |
| [`resilience`](#resilience) | Resilience / DR: Velero backups (cloud bucket + identity created on demand), kured reboots, descheduler; `cs dr` runs backups, restores and drills | 3 | 0 |
| [`chaos`](#chaos) | Chaos engineering: Chaos Mesh (+ LitmusChaos extra); `cs chaos run` executes automated experiments with a PASS/FAIL report | 1 | 1 |

```bash
cloudseed platform list            # the catalog with what is installed on the current cluster
cloudseed platform info basek8s    # every tool a group brings
cloudseed platform plan basek8s    # what an install would do
cloudseed platform install basek8s
```

## Web UIs

`cloudseed platform ui` attaches an HTTPRoute on the shared private Gateway for every installed item below and prints its URL (`https://<item>.<domain>`) and login. Generated passwords live in `<workdir>/platform/secrets.json` (0600).

| Item | Namespace / service | Login |
|---|---|---|
| `airflow` | `airflow/airflow-api-server:8080` | admin / airflow\_password (platform/secrets.json) |
| `argocd` | `argocd/argocd-server:80` | admin / kubectl -n argocd get secret argocd-initial-admin-secret -o jsonpath='{.data.password}' &#124; base64 -d |
| `artifactory` | `artifactory/artifactory:8082` | admin / artifactory\_password (platform/secrets.json) |
| `chaos-mesh` | `chaos-mesh/chaos-dashboard:2333` | token: cs kubectl create token cloudseed-chaos-admin -n chaos-mesh --duration=24h |
| `falco` | `falco/falco-falcosidekick-ui:2802` | admin / falco\_ui\_password (platform/secrets.json) |
| `gitlab` | `gitlab/gitlab-webservice-default:8181` | root / kubectl -n gitlab get secret gitlab-gitlab-initial-root-password -o jsonpath='{.data.password}' &#124; base64 -d |
| `harbor` | `harbor/harbor:80` | admin / harbor\_password (platform/secrets.json) |
| `jupyterhub` | `jupyterhub/proxy-public:80` | any user / jupyter\_password (platform/secrets.json) |
| `kagent` | `kagent/kagent-ui:8080` | admin / kagent\_password (platform/secrets.json) |
| `kiali` | `istio-system/kiali:20001` | anonymous |
| `kube-prometheus-stack` | `monitoring/monitoring-grafana:80` | admin / grafana\_password (platform/secrets.json) |
| `kubecost-cost-analyzer` | `kubecost/kubecost-cost-analyzer:9090` | – |
| `kubeflow-pipelines` | `kubeflow/ml-pipeline-ui:80` | – |
| `langfuse` | `langfuse/langfuse-web:3000` | sign up on first visit |
| `litmus` | `litmus/litmus-frontend-service:9091` | admin / litmus (change it) |
| `minio` | `minio/minio-console:9001` | minio\_root\_user / minio\_password (platform/secrets.json; admin when minio\_root\_user is not there: an install from before cloudseed generated it) |
| `mlflow` | `mlflow/mlflow:80` | – |
| `neuvector` | `neuvector/neuvector-service-webui:8443` | admin / admin (change it) |
| `nexus` | `nexus/nexus-nexus3:8081` | admin / nexus\_password (platform/secrets.json) |
| `open-webui` | `open-webui/open-webui:80` | sign up on first visit |
| `opencost` | `opencost/opencost:9090` | – |
| `sonarqube` | `sonarqube/sonarqube-sonarqube:9000` | admin / admin (change it) |
| `spark-history-server` | `spark-operator/spark-history-server:18080` | – |
| `trino` | `trino/trino:8080` | any user, no password |

## Step-overs and conflicts

- `cluster-autoscaler` is built into gke, aks: cloudseed skips it there.
- `metrics-server` is built into rke2, gke, aks: cloudseed skips it there.
- `agentgateway` overlaps `envoy-gateway`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `artifactory` overlaps `harbor`, `nexus`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `chaos-mesh` overlaps `litmus`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `cluster-autoscaler` overlaps `karpenter`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `envoy-gateway` overlaps `ingress-nginx`, `istio-gateway`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `falco` overlaps `neuvector`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `harbor` overlaps `artifactory`, `nexus`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `ingress-nginx` overlaps `envoy-gateway`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `istio-gateway` overlaps `envoy-gateway`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `karpenter` overlaps `cluster-autoscaler`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `kubecost-cost-analyzer` conflicts with `opencost`: the later one is skipped unless `--force`.
- `kubeflow-pipelines` overlaps `minio`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `kubescape-operator` overlaps `trivy-operator`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `litmus` overlaps `chaos-mesh`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `neuvector` overlaps `falco`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `nexus` overlaps `harbor`, `artifactory`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `opencost` conflicts with `kubecost-cost-analyzer`: the later one is skipped unless `--force`.
- `trivy-operator` overlaps `neuvector`: both can run, the plan warns.
- `vault` overlaps `external-secrets`, `sealed-secrets`: both can run, the plan warns.
